from funcy.flow import stale
import time

# Test basic stale functionality
calls = []
cache = {}

@stale(timeout=1, cache=cache, key_func=lambda x: 0)
def f(x):
    calls.append(x)
    return x * 2

# First call - should compute
r1 = f(1)
print(f"First call: r1={r1}, calls={calls}")
assert r1 == 2
assert calls == [1]

# Second call before expiry - should use cache
r2 = f(2)
print(f"Second call (cached): r2={r2}, calls={calls}")
assert r2 == 2  # Same result due to key_func=lambda x: 0
assert calls == [1]  # f not called again

# Advance clock past timeout
time.sleep(1.1)

# Third call after expiry - should recompute
r3 = f(3)
print(f"Third call (expired): r3={r3}, calls={calls}")
assert r3 == 6
assert calls == [1, 3]  # f called twice total

# Fourth call before next expiry - should use cached value
r4 = f(4)
print(f"Fourth call (cached): r4={r4}, calls={calls}")
assert r4 == 6  # Cached from third call
assert calls == [1, 3]  # f not called again

print("All stale tests passed!")
